title: Dark Trap Half-Time
description: A half-time trap beat in F minor at 140 BPM, no swing: snare-style clap on beat 3, kick on 1 and the and of 3, 1/16 hats with velocity accents and rising 1/32 hat rolls, a long sub bass on F, Db and Eb with a slide at the end of the phrase, a bell motif and a dark pad. Arranged as intro, verse, pre-chorus with a beat of silence before the drop, drop, verse, pre-chorus, drop and outro (44 bars, about 1 minute 15). Checked on paper and with measurements only; not listened to.
